Merging v1 logic into v2 would introduce dead code paths and break v2's internal contracts. The upgrade is a clean replacement, not an extension.

Ship v2 as a new file (validate_managed_patch_preservation_v2.py) and keep v1. Rejected because having two validators with overlapping scope creates confusion about which is authoritative; the workspace validator invocation path must be unambiguous.
